warnings: Axes: x = grids 1-8 at 3.00 / 3.00 / 3.00 / 4.00 / 3.00 / 3.00 / 3.00 (22.00); y = rows A, B, C, D at 4.10 / 1.90 / 3.00 (9.00). Origin A1 (top-left). Scanned government set (สพฐ.), page content rotated 90 degrees; every value read off the rendered page.

The bottom row carries no grid bubble on any structural plan (S-01..S-04). It is named D because S-11's B9/B10 elevations print the markers A, C, D under the spans 6.00 / 3.00, and the architectural plan A-05 labels it D — two sheets agree, so D is used, not a dummy.

Four lines are not printed as exact dimensions: 3' (7.00) and 5' (14.90) carry the steel beams T1 on S-04 and are scaled; A''''' (3.00) is the upper-roof ridge on S-06 (drawn midway, not dimensioned, scaled); B' (4.23) is printed only approximately as '~1.77' on S-05. Each carries its own note/flag.

Edge lines from different sheets sit close together but are different edges: x 1' -1.10 (S-03 ground-slab edge) vs 1'' -1.00 (S-05 roof edge), 8' 23.00 vs 8'' 23.10; y A' -1.20 (roof edge, S-05/S-06) vs A'' -1.10 (ground slab, S-03); D' 10.10 (ground slab, S-03) vs D'' 10.20 (lower roof, S-04). All kept.

Dimension sweep covers the structural sheets S-01..S-11 (pages 24-34) plus the stair detail A-14 (page 16, extracted as a section). The other architectural/MEP sheets (pages 3-23) were not swept in this op04 (pass2-only) run, so their levels (+0.45/+0.50 room tags, ระดับพื้นชั้นลอย etc.) are not recorded; A-05 was only consulted to confirm the D label and the 1.65/0.70/2.10 chain. Footing, beam, slab and connection details on S-05..S-11 print only member-internal dimensions, which stay on their elements.
